$comment: THE ONE TABLE OF THE NIST ACCEPTANCE BASIS (kb/Work PB5460): the comparison normalization of a CCVS report, applied
identically to the golden and to what the program printed. The rule exists in two languages by nature:
scripts/guard-verdict.sh (guard_normalize_into, the CLI guard) and NistRunner.Normalize
(tests/WiseOwl.Cobol.Tests.Conformance/NistRunner.cs, the in-process gate). BOTH are held to every case below:
scripts/guard-verify.sh --self-test (bash), so a change to either side that the other does not make fails a test.
THE RULE. Lines end at LF. Every CR goes, with the spaces before it (CR LF golden against LF output, and the
OVERPRINT a WRITE ... ADVANCING 0 writes, `marker   \rtext`, kb/Work PB1667, PB2509). The spaces before a FORM FEED
go (a record of a print stream is written whole, so its padding precedes the page eject an ADVANCING PAGE writes;
it strikes nothing), and the form feed STAYS: a page eject is not a line advance, so a runtime that wrote one for
the other differs. NEL, LS, PS and a vertical tab are characters, not line ends. Each line loses its trailing
spaces (spaces only), the COMPUTED= operand some CCVS programs print is masked, and trailing empty lines and the
